title: Listen: a reload shows the position the pagehide beacon saved
reason: The reader route reads the Listen seed before the pagehide beacon lands, so a reload while playing can show up to 15 s back (seen 0:37 against 0:40; the next load showed 0:40). Accepted as built at P41-sr's review round 1.
trigger: a replayed stretch is noticed after a reload, or the next Listen position work
